patterns.description: fleet-envelope repo unifies 5 event systems into one grammar. This is the structural pattern the CNS bus was reaching for but couldn't achieve — a typed message envelope that all ship systems speak. Combined with USCP packets for inter-officer comms, this forms a two-layer protocol: system events (envelope) + officer signals (USCP).
patterns.implication: The CNS bus should adopt the fleet-event-envelope schema. USCP packets wrap inside envelopes. One grammar, two layers.

patterns.description: The Overknowledge Problem was misdiagnosed. The real issue is GPU memory contention — running 5 models on one GPU means 3-4 time out on every cycle. The daemon works but the hardware can't sustain it.
patterns.implication: Serial model sessions, not parallel. One model at a time, deeper prompts, longer context. Quality over quantity.
